citations.claim: body centre at wall face with radius 0.5 overlapping wall 0 by 0.5, exceeding 0.15 limit
one step earlier body was 1.5m from wall, so it traversed ~2m in one step into the wall

explanation: High-speed body (vx=60, dt=1/30 => 2m per step) hits thin wall (thickness 0.1). Despite 68 substeps, the impulse/positional correction lets the centre stop at the wall face with full-radius overlap (0.5 > 0.15 limit), i.e. discrete collision handling fails for fast-vs-thin impact.
vision_note: The red body moves rightward toward the thin vertical wall across steps 1 to 3. At step 4 it ends up centered directly on the wall line, embedded in the wall instead of remaining outside it.
